reason: Tools don't grow channels, consistency and luck do. I already check YouTube Studio every morning for free, and I'd rather copy what the Hindi guys in my feed say than pay a bot to tell me what my own numbers already show.
objection: Why would an AI know my audience better than I do, when it only sees the same analytics I can already open myself?
would_change_my_mind: A free trial that correctly predicts which of my next few videos will beat my usual views, and gives a title or thumbnail idea that actually gets clicks.
